## About Me

My background sits at the intersection of market research, business strategy, and data analytics. Before graduate school, I worked on research and analysis across retail and consumer sectors, developing market forecasts, assessing competitive landscapes, and translating complex findings into insights for business decision-making.

I am now complementing that experience with hands-on work in Python, SQL, business intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, and cloud analytics, with a focus on using data to answer practical business questions.

[Learn more about me →](about.qmd)
